[P2] Keep concurrency budgets separate for concurrent runs

Concurrent calls sharing a scheduler overwrite the same `_concurrency` value and share `_active`. Starting a second run with a larger limit can therefore admit additional cases from an existing serial run; a smaller limit can block the existing run's otherwise admissible work until lease timeouts. The run-ownership leases explicitly support sharing a scheduler across runs, so this affects supported usage. Key the budget and active count by run identity while preserving atomic acquisition with target capacity, and test overlapping runs with different limits.
